Achievements & spotlights
Joseph Staten & Pete Stacker
Nine games each, the most of anyone in this dataset. Both are credited under Bungie, 343 Industries, and Halo Studios.
Steve Downes & Jen Taylor
Credited as the voices of Master Chief and Cortana on eight of the mainline games, every one except Halo 3: ODST.
Martin O'Donnell & Michael Salvatori
Credited on every game from Combat Evolved through Halo 4. The Halo 4 credit is for two music cues, plus a separate thank-you line. Halo 5 lists them only under Special Thanks, with no work credit.
Adam Crockett
Credited as a Cinematic Artist on Combat Evolved in 2001, then as a Gameplay Animator on Campaign Evolved in 2026, 25 years later, with no credit on any game in between.
Jason Jones
Credited on four games, the last in 2010. His 2026 appearance is a reprint of the 2001 roster, not a new credit.
Frank O'Connor
Credited on eight games from 2004 to 2021, titled Community Team on Halo 2 and Franchise Creative Director by Halo Infinite. No Campaign Evolved credit under this name.
Greg Hermann
Credited on eight games across all three studios, with a title change on nearly every one: Engineering Lead on Halo 3: ODST and Halo: Reach, Principal Development Lead on Combat Evolved Anniversary, Technical Director on TMCC, Director of Technology on Halo Infinite, and GM Game Director on Campaign Evolved. Halo 5 lists him only under Special Thanks.
Mike Madeoy, Chris Wicklund, Mark Dias & Tawnya Pettiford-Wates
Four more of the five people sharing the dataset's longest gap. All four voiced Marines in Combat Evolved in 2001, then reprised the same characters in Campaign Evolved in 2026: Private Bisenti, PFC Fitzgerald, Private Mendoza, and Echo 419 (Foehammer).
Jeff Steitzer
The announcer in every game with multiplayer or Firefight. Absent from Halo 2 and every TMCC release, despite recording new lines for Halo 2: Anniversary's multiplayer as part of TMCC. A real gap in the available credits, not an error in this dataset.

  • With the exception of MCC's post-launch updates, every game's credits are taken from its initial release, not from later patches.
  • A remade or remastered game's original credits are not counted as new work for the remaster: Combat Evolved Anniversary and Campaign Evolved do not double-count Combat Evolved's own 2001 credits, and a name appearing only because a remaster reprints the original roster is not treated as a new appearance.
  • The Master Chief Collection's February 2025 update credited only community Reclaimer volunteers, no developers; those 50 names are shown in "MCC post 2018" (teal) but are not counted toward any developer or vendor statistic.
Source: Halopedia, Halo Waypoint, IGDB credit rolls. Full methodology at [link].
